cause_quote: Adding `props.runStatus?.phase ?? ""` and `props.runStatus?.occurredAt ?? 0` to `trackTranscriptRenderDependencies` made status-only updates invalidate every settled message row.
summary: The fix removes run status phase and timestamp from the transcript render dependencies so status-only updates leave settled messages idle.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #124301, where the composer already displayed interruption feedback and the transcript render guard did not depend on run status. #124301 moved interruption feedback into its own transcript row and also added status to the shared render dependencies, causing settled messages to rerender even on completion-only updates. #127823 moved the feedback back to the composer and left both dependencies in place.
